status: Targeted palette viewport migration; full matrices reserved for larger blocks per user cadence.

snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

build_scope.limit: Current-main network policy excluded from this frozen UI-lab binary and acceptance.

coretext_inherited.scope: Unmodified text harness/implementation; 180 SDK font/direction cases plus raster are inherited, not rerun.

contracts: Palette suggestions use Rust viewport extent/allocation, authoritative fractional offset and reveal/clamp; Views retains native ScrollView behavior and its existing contents-preferred-size policy.

A shared height-range setter preserves dynamic 90..300 result caps across window sizes. Separate overflow-indicator policy retains palette edge indicators without changing its background to a modal dialog color.

The existing custom Rust-backed scrollbar remains injected for Metal. Native ScrollView synchronization/subscription state is removed for the palette. Scene projection and native row hit testing consume the viewport offset.

The new shared actual-palette case injects 30 Unicode results and checks ownership, compact/wide result caps, bottom/first-row reveal, keyboard wrap and selected-row visibility, shrinking to one result, no-result hiding and reopening.
Existing palette tests cover asynchronous results and stable selection, stale profile/query rejection, IME admission, native click after scroll, text/error/theme/fallback and editor lifetime.
Native measurement, View/node identity, platform event/focus/AX/window/scrollbar/animation adapters remain. No dependency, browser service/store/admission or persistence change.

previous_full_checkpoint.scope: Earlier full pass predates palette viewport migration; it is not a full pass of this source.

remaining: Horizontal footer workspace dots still use native ScrollView.
Other native control/node/container/menu/window/input ownership and complete functional/manual/release parity remain open.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation/input-latency/memory gain established.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.

initial_probe.note: The new actual-palette fixture timed out in RunUntil(offset > 0) after keyboard wrap in both backends. The first reading of the TestFuture timeout as a presentation wait was incorrect: RunUntil itself uses TestFuture. A subsequent explicit native focus change did not resolve it. The failing logs/source hashes are retained.

second_probe.note: Explicit native-window focus did not resolve the initial failure; both probes reached keyboard selection and timed out in RunUntil(offset > 0). Inspection found pending 120ms debounced search could replace the injected long list. The final fixture waits for a real titled-tab search sentinel, drains history, then injects results and asserts their count. No production behavior changed for these fixture corrections.

third_probe.note: Waiting for actual debounced data exposed the next oracle error: the palette has 9px top border/padding; minimal first-row reveal must align to the row top, not offset zero. The final fixture checks first-row alignment/visibility and keyboard-selected row visibility without forcing an extra scroll policy.

fourth_probe.note: Views passed. Metal passed geometry/scroll/selection but the final no-result check read overlay visibility before the queued scene update. The final fixture waits for the scene to hide, retaining the actual visibility condition. Production behavior unchanged.
